goal: Provide a reusable way to determine whether a supplied value is a valid email address and return a clear valid-or-invalid result.

alternatives.title: Practical syntax validator
tradeoffs: May reject uncommon but standards-compliant addresses or accept some addresses that cannot actually receive mail.
Keeps behavior predictable, lightweight, and suitable for common application input.

alternatives.title: Standards-focused validator
tradeoffs: Adds complexity and may require a maintained validation dependency.
Supports more unusual standards-compliant address formats and avoids maintaining intricate parsing rules locally.

self_critique.weakest_point: The meaning of "valid" is unsettled, so exact expected behavior cannot yet be specified.
self_critique.cut_or_change: Resolve the required validation strictness, then replace the broad examples with an explicit set of accepted and rejected edge cases.
